mcp_tools.name: prd_with_testable_acceptance_criteria
mcp_tools.title: Prd with testable acceptance criteria
mcp_tools.description: Submits a product requirements record (problem and outcome statements, user-story and acceptance-criteria rows, scope fences with declared out-of-scope items, priorities and decisions, open-question rows and approval, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRD_WITH_TESTABLE_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_READY / PRD_WITH_TESTABLE_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed story-to-criteria traceability and testable/binary coverage checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared PRD record only; it writes no requirements and judges no product's worth.

inputSchema.description: The prd with testable acceptance criteria manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

out_of_scope_items.description: Declared out of scope items (plain strings).

expect.notes: All requirements met. Computed spot checks: stories_count=1, p0_story_count=1, story_criteria_coverage=1.000000
